messages:
john_acme: Hi - we've been seeing a lot of 429s on our integration since yesterday evening, bursty errors and some long tails in latency. Sample request IDs: req_20260312_01 req_20260312_02. Can you help gather repro evidence?
alex_support: Sorry about that — can you share a curl repro and one or two full request IDs (the x-rw-request-id)? Also the response headers if you have them.
maria_engineer: pinging eng-oncall, we need headers (x-rw-rate-limit-remaining/x-rw-rate-limit-reset) and the client IPs. If possible a short timeline: when first saw, peak, and end.
john_acme: attaching a redacted curl that reproduces 429 for us:
```bash
curl -i "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"test"}'
```
Response headers from one sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-request-id: req_20260312_01
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 18
x-rw-quota-name: default
```
alex_support: perfect. Can you also run a HAR capture or `curl -v` with `-D -` to include headers, and paste the full response body if available. If you can, upload a debug bundle (we'll send a presigned link).
john_acme: running HAR now, will upload to the link. Timeline: first saw 2026-03-12T18:03:12Z, spikes between 18:03-18:10 with ~120 req/min, then intermittent until 18:40. Our app retries with backoff (500ms->1s), but retries also hit 429s.
eng-oncall-bot: RateLimiter detected quota breach: quota=default region=us-east1 peak_rps=2.1K window=60s at 2026-03-12T18:04:07Z (req sample: req_20260312_02)
maria_engineer: thanks — @john_acme please confirm if you use multiple API keys or a single key here. If multiple, share the other request ids. Also send client IP block if you can.
john_acme: single key. Extra sample ids: req_20260312_03 req_20260312_04. IPs: 52.24.12.45, 52.24.12.46. Uploading HAR now to the link you sent.
sre_jen: adding note — from our side we saw concurrent connections spike and batching didn't kick in. We'll check routing buckets and whether a sudden fanout caused per-key quota exhaustion.
alex_support: linking the uploaded artifacts and debug bundle to the ticket, will escalate to infra with the HAR and request id timeline. Thanks, we'll follow up when eng has root cause. :thumbsup:
john_acme: thanks, appreciate the quick triage :)
